title: The Imaging Source IC4 camera managerProperties

cameraSerial.description: Camera serial number. null opens the first available camera; a value starting with 'MOCK_' loads a mock camera for headless testing. Preferred over a positional list index, which silently rebinds when USB enumeration order changes.

cameraPixelSizeUm.description: Optically effective (sample-plane) pixel size in micrometers.

maxQueuedFrames.description: Bound on retained undrained frames. Oldest are dropped past this, with a single warning.

pixelFormat.description: GenICam PixelFormat, e.g. 'Mono8' or 'Mono16'. null leaves the device default.

trigger_mode.description: 'Hardware' arms the external trigger at startup. Scans may arm and disarm it at runtime.

trigger_source.description: GenICam TriggerSource, e.g. 'Line1'. null leaves the device default. Confirm the wired line on the rig.
